# Observation labels (`observations.score_kind`)

<!-- GENERATED by `python3 -m nanobody_opt.observation_labels --markdown > docs/OBSERVATION_LABELS.md`. Edit nanobody_opt/observation_labels.py, not this file. -->

**Rule: a `score_kind` names one scale.** A new formula, field or pass count gets a new label; an old label is closed, never re-used. `source` says who/what population wrote a row; it never changes what `score` means.

Enforced at write time by `mutation_network.update_observation_store` (`check_observations`): strict labels refuse wrong writer / formula / source (logged as `OBSERVATION_LABEL_REFUSED` in `pipeline_failures.jsonl`); other labels warn on stderr and refuse with `NOVA_LABEL_ENFORCE=1`. Writers of strict labels also run `assert_formula` against a pinned golden field before scoring. `tools/check_observation_labels.py` is the read-only DB trip-wire (unregistered labels, off-range or jumping per-epoch medians).

## Formulas

- `sum10`: sum of the ten per-metric dense ranks within the field (the validator's published final_score; rho=1.000 on our submissions)
- `category3`: dense-rank each of the 3 metric categories' rank-sums, sum the 3 category ranks (briefly live 2026-10-09; rho=0.918, WRONG)
- `algo2`: Algorithm-2 minmax: drop liability_num_violations>50, then max over 6 weighted metrics of (average rank / weight) (novelty reference only)
- `validator_published`: the validator's own published final_score / rank-sum

## Labels

### `validator_final_rank_sum`

- class: validator; formula: `validator_published`; passes per value: 1
- scale: validator's published rank-sum for the epoch; ~13-340; lower=better
- field: that epoch's real competition field
- sources: `heldout_prior_public_field`, `public_validator_api`
- writers: `audit_live_generator_recall`, `seed_mutation_database`, `select_elite_parents`
- trip-wire range: 1 to 600
- introduced: <2026-09

### `local_validator_replay_rank_sum`

- class: derived; formula: `sum10`; passes per value: None
- scale: producer replay rank-sum vs sampled ~49-sequence replay fields from recent public epochs; ~20-370; lower=better
- field: replayed epoch fields (~49 sequences)
- sources: `backfill_8x`, `children_20x`, `children_40x`, `children_8x`, `exhaustive_8x`, `live_exact_repeat`, `live_exact_screen`, `local_exact_raw`
- writers: closed / unrecorded
- trip-wire range: 1 to 600
- introduced: <2026-09
- notes: Producer scale ONLY. Readers must also filter by source (build_top50_index.REPLAY_SCALE_SOURCES).
- KNOWN OFF-SCALE rows from `hf_archive_top200`: 800 rows, ~5.8e4, epoch NULL, no writer in the repo (audit §3a); not on this scale
- KNOWN OFF-SCALE rows from `public_multipass_rivals`: 2 rows, epoch 25586 pass1 (49367.5 and 53891): a partial multipass run whose formula (algo2 vs category3) cannot be pinned; the relabel refused them, so they stay here, off-scale

### `multipass_sum10_pass`

- class: raw_pass (strict); formula: `sum10`; passes per value: 1
- scale: ONE fast-scorer pass, sum-of-10 dense rank-sum vs the full HF archive field (~61k rows on 2026-10-09); per pass ~8.5e4-2.1e5, epoch mean ~1.2e5; lower=better. The CURRENT multipass label.
- field: hf_archive_full (field_rows + field_sha256 in provenance)
- sources: `public_multipass_rivals`
- writers: `backfill_multipass_metrics`, `hf_field_refresh`, `migrate_hf_field_20x`, `multipass_all_rivals`, `relabel_multipass_legacy`
- trip-wire range: 50000 to 260000
- epochs: 25533-25534, 25593-25603 (backfilled from disk), 25613-25618 (relabelled, no metrics), 25619+ (native); 25598-25616 also hold migrated master 20x passes (ids hf20x_pass:*)
- introduced: 2026-10-09
- notes: Rows written natively or by backfill_multipass_metrics carry raw metrics_json + field fingerprint. Rows relabelled by relabel_multipass_legacy (25613-25618) have no metrics and an unrecorded hf_archive snapshot; same formula and field type. Rows from migrate_hf_field_20x are the raw per-pass metrics of master's killed 20x hf_field_refresh runs (same scorer, validator-dual-sample-v1, read back from master disk); epoch = the refresh run's epoch, cohort derived per sequence.

## `public_multipass_rivals` history (2026-10-09 relabel)

Until 2026-10-09 every dashboard multipass pass row was written as `local_validator_replay_rank_sum`. The formula behind a row depends on when the row was last written (an upsert on `public_multipass:epoch<E>:<seq>:pass<k>`), not on the epoch number. Box deploy times are taken from the `multipass_all_rivals.py.bak.*` backups on the dashboard box. Each regime was verified by recomputing all three formulas from raw metrics.

| Epochs (DB state after relabel) | Formula | Written (UTC, 2026-10-09) | Now labelled |
|---|---|---|---|
| 25559-25610 (except back-filled) | algo2 | before 14:01:40Z (old build; 25610 run started 13:37Z) | `legacy_multipass_algo2_pass` |
| 25536-25538, 25611-25612 | category3 | 14:01:40Z-17:19:41Z (category3 build live) | `legacy_multipass_category3_pass` |
| 25613-25618 | sum10 | after 17:25:15Z (sum10 build) | `multipass_sum10_pass` (no metrics) |
| 25533-25534, 25593-25603 | sum10 (re-derived from disk passes) | backfill 2026-10-09/10 | `multipass_sum10_pass` (with metrics; original score/kind in provenance) |
| 25619+ | sum10 | native | `multipass_sum10_pass` |
| 25586 (2 rows) | algo2 or category3, undeterminable | unknown | left as `local_validator_replay_rank_sum` (refused by the fingerprint guard) |

The relabel (`tools/relabel_multipass_legacy.py`, applied 2026-10-10 00:5xZ, 24,398 rows) only changes `score_kind` and adds provenance (`relabeled_from`, `formula`, `formula_evidence`); scores are untouched.
